instruction: Open the image file 'photo.jpg' from the Pictures folder, crop the image to remove the left side, and then save the edited image as 'photo_cropped.jpg' in the Pictures folder.
evaluator: [ -f ~/Pictures/photo.jpg ] && [ -f ~/Pictures/photo_cropped.jpg ] && python3 -c "from PIL import Image; import os; orig_img = Image.open(os.path.expanduser('~/Pictures/photo.jpg')); cropped_img = Image.open(os.path.expanduser('~/Pictures/photo_cropped.jpg')); exit(0 if (cropped_img.width < orig_img.width and cropped_img.height == orig_img.height) else 1)" && echo True || echo False
